_meta.description: Curated design DNA descriptors for B2B SaaS marketing/dashboard apps that surface on Mobbin Pro's trending web feed. The forge pipeline merges these descriptors with live palette+element data so gpt-oss-120b inherits each app's actual visual signature instead of treating the app name as a string.
_meta.schema: { display: typography display family hint; body: typography body family hint; mono?: typography mono family hint; weights: 'thin'|'precise'|'bold'|'editorial'; layout: hero+composition signature; copy: copy register; accents: 1-2 brand color hex hints; doctrine: 3-4 imperative moves to inherit; avoid: list of generic SaaS tropes this app deliberately rejects; sections?: ordered list of {type, variant?, note?} entries naming the SUPPORTED_SECTION_TYPES this anchor's homepage actually uses (consumed by mobbinSiteSpecBlock to bias site-spec gen toward anchor-appropriate sections instead of generic SaaS sections); composition?: a paragraph describing the homepage's section-by-section structure with concrete surface details (consumed by mobbinSessionBlock as detailed layout reference for homepage LLM gen) }
_meta.fallback: Apps not in this bank get a palette-only descriptor synthesized at runtime from the sampled Mobbin Pro screen colors.

Linear.layout: Dense single-screen storytelling. Hero followed immediately by a high-density product surface (cycles/triage/projects view). Pricing toggle styled as a segmented control, not pills. Multi-column footer with hairline rules.
Linear.copy: Outcome-driven verbs ('Move work forward', 'Streamline issues'). Product nouns are concrete and proprietary ('Cycles', 'Triage', 'Initiatives'). Zero hyperbole. Sentence-case headings.
doctrine: Map sampled palette into theme.extend.colors with violet-indigo as primary
Ship one product-preview band immediately after hero with realistic data labels
Use ring-1 ring-white/8 + backdrop-blur on every card; corner radius 8-10px, never 16+
avoid: aurora hero blobs as the only visual
